notes.title: NOOK FALL: West Town Joins the East Asia Indie Games Celebration
notes.notes:
[p]Hello players,

NOOK FALL: West Town is participating in the East Asia Indie Games Celebration.

[b]"NOOK FALL: West Town"[/b] is an isometric visual novel game. Set in a fictional small town called "West Town," the game revolves around a festival celebration about to take place. As an outsider arriving in West Town, you will, over the course of more than ten days, interact and explore, gradually uncovering the current state of the town and a story from thirty years ago.

Wishlist NOOK FALL:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119700/NOOK_FALL_West_Town/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
